arguments.message:
Timestamps are stored in UTC and shown in the timezone set for your account. If they’re several hours off, check that your personal timezone is set correctly:
1. Click your profile picture → **Settings → Profile**.
2. In the **Timezone** field, choose your local timezone and save.

If you haven’t set a personal timezone, the dashboard falls back to the workspace default (Settings → General). Updating either your personal timezone or the workspace default will align the timestamps with your local time.
